journal_lines: Found a clearing. The trees lean inward around it.
Mushrooms growing up the trunks, not just the ground.
Long claw marks on the trunk. Higher than I wanted to think.
The inside of the dark oak was pale. Did not expect that.
The canopy here closes over the sun like a lid on a pot.
A clearing in the dark forest is not always a clearing. Some are doorways.
Toadstools the size of dinner plates, in rings. Did not step in the rings.
Worked quickly. The trees did not seem to like the axe.
Light here is brown, not green. Like looking through tea.
Something coughed in the understory. Did not investigate. Worked the far edge instead.
